description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Shapley value across various positional categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered sequentially from left to right as $L_{4^+}$, $L_3$, $L_2$, $L_1$, $T$, $R_1$, $R_2$, $R_3$, and $R_{4^+}$, without an explicit axis label. The vertical value axis is labeled "Shapley value" and features a linear scale with a labeled range from 0 to 80, marked by tick intervals of 20, though the axis extends slightly below zero to accommodate negative values. The chart utilizes grouped bars to represent three distinct models, as indicated by the legend: mBERT (light blue-grey), XLM-R (dark blue-grey), and chLSTM (olive green). Within each category, the three bars are arranged side-by-side in this respective order, and all bars are outlined in a thin black stroke. The values vary significantly across the categories, with the $T$ category containing the tallest bars; specifically, the chLSTM bar in the $T$ group reaches the maximum approximate value of 79, while mBERT and XLM-R in the same group are approximately 59 and 54, respectively. The $L_1$ and $R_1$ categories show moderate positive values ranging from approximately 9 to 14 across all models. The remaining categories display much lower values, generally between -2 and 5. The shortest bars are found in the chLSTM model for categories $R_2$, $R_3$, and $R_{4^+}$, which dip slightly below the zero line to approximate values of -2 and -1. The categories are not sorted by value but follow a specific alphanumeric sequence, and horizontal grid lines corresponding to the y-axis tick marks are present across the plot area to visually emphasize the scale.
